title: k2m5-family: certificates, checkers, Lean proof and paper for s(k^2-5)=k, k>=7
description: We prove s(k^2-5)=k for every integer k>=7, where s(n) is the side of the smallest square that contains n unit squares with disjoint interiors, rotations allowed. The cases k=7,8,9 are known certificates; for all k>=10 one family of weighted measures on [0,k]^2 (corner module, periodic wall pattern, Lebesgue middle; total mass k^2-4D with D=1.3405...>5/4) is shown valid by reducing, through a locality lemma, to a single 11x11 board, which is checked with Daniel's interval checker zmx2 and a new Tight-Tile Lemma. This archive holds the certificate, the checkers, the Lean reduction, the Tight-Tile checker and its outputs, and the paper.
